name: radar-cross-section-in-sp-roundtrip
source: EUROCONTROL-SPEC-0149-9 Edition 1.21, UAP (FRN 35 SP) and the SP item structure; IEEE 754 single for 0.25 is 3E800000; built by hand from asterix-cat062 vector 15
reference: FRN 35 set in the fifth FSPEC octet (0x02). SP: LEN 05 counts itself, then 3E800000, the single 0.25. LEN of the block 0x26 = 3 (CAT, LEN) + 5 (FSPEC) + 25 (items) + 5 (SP).
